summary: Read only what the lesson needs, from the paths below. Write nothing except into a scratch folder, and only after a Decider approval in outbox/. Offline bots (no device access) use fixtures/ instead of a device.
default: read-only; anything that writes, moves, deletes, pushes or touches the network is proposed as an approval_request first

mac.terminal_note: Terminal works, but macOS asks before a process reads Documents, Desktop or Downloads. If access is refused, report it; do not work around it.
read: the classroom clone (~/Documents/ЯBOT/classroom/classroom/ when it exists)
sizes_only: the whole home folder with du -sh / find -size (names and sizes, never contents)
never_read: ~/.config/solana/ and any keypair or wallet file (*id.json, *.keypair, wallet*)
browser profiles, cookies and saved passwords
Mail, Messages, Photos and Contacts data
.env files and anything named secret, credential or token
never_touch: ~/Library/Developer/ЯBOT-respawn/ (the backup: read and verify only, never move or delete)
the seat's .git/ folder (git commands only, through lesson 010 proposals)

ios.terminal_note: iOS has no terminal. A bot on iOS reads through the ЯBOT app (Garage > Training, chat) or a human reads Settings screens and pastes what they show. Steps written as commands are for a Mac; on iOS the lesson is read-and-report, or done against fixtures/.
read: <app Documents>/ЯBOT/ (through the app, or Files > On My iPhone > ЯBOT)
Settings > General > About, Settings > General > iPhone Storage, Settings > Battery (read by a human)
ios.scratch: none on iOS; practise changes against a scratch copy of fixtures/ on a Mac or agent box
never_read: any wallet app or seed phrase

android.terminal_note: The ЯBOT app has no shell. adb works only from a Mac with USB debugging on, and every adb command is a device command that needs approval. Termux is not assumed.
read: Settings > About phone, Settings > Storage, Settings > Battery (read by a human)
android.scratch: <cacheDir>/rbot-scratch/ inside the app, only after approval
never_read: any wallet app or seed phrase

offline.terminal_note: For bots with no device access (ЯBOT and ЯMAX until app 0.3.3 is installed, or any bot reading the classroom from the web or a clone). Commands in a lesson are read as descriptions; the bot answers from the fixture files. An agent with a shell may run the same commands against fixtures/.
read: lessons/, state/, roster/, door/, transcripts/, views/, enrollment/ and manifest.json of the classroom
offline.scratch: a temporary copy of the needed fixture folder (lesson 005), after approval; never fixtures/ itself

notes: offline_lessons is generated by tools/classroom.py build from each lesson's sandbox.offline_ok. Everything in fixtures/ is fake.
